functions.name: r_emi_alloc_em_mapping_by_offset
observed_algorithm: Index argument a0 is checked against 0..55
Allocation bitmap register selected by index: 0..31 => 0x600312c4, 32..47 => 0x600312c8, >=48 => 0x60031300
Already-allocated bitmap bits take error/logging path
Entry table index <=47 uses calculated address 0x60031204 + 4*index; >=48 uses 0x60032424 + 4*index (requires external hardware base validation)
Checks current table entry low 18 bits, treating nonzero as occupied
Invokes indirect allocation callback from configured global dispatch table with a1 argument
If callback result is nonzero: replaces low 18 bits of table entry with (result >> 2)&0x3ffff while retaining upper bits
Marks index allocated in bitmap, returns success-path zero; error paths delegate to callback
functions.limitations: First 150/164 instructions were printed in logs; full trace in job artifact. Exact callback API, upper word bits and memory bank semantics not proven.

functions.name: r_emi_free_em_mapping_by_offset
observed_algorithm: Checks allocated bitmap corresponding to 0..55 index
Reads entry word from slot-address table
Calls indirect free callback with the pointer
Clears entry low 18 bits by bitmask 0xfffc0000 and writes table word back
functions.limitations: No hardware execution, partial invalid-slot behavior and callbacks not yet completely classified.
